title: set_rank_config resets joined node state but keeps lowest_rank logic inconsistent
description: File: rust/lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs Lines 260-279. When rank config changes on a Joined node: rank and lowest_rank are set to INFINITE_RANK, then select_parent() is called. If select_parent() finds a valid parent, lowest_rank is updated. But if no valid parent exists after the config change (all parents inadmissible with new config), the node becomes Unjoined with lowest_rank=INFINITE_RANK. Later DIOs could re-join at any rank. Edge case: A config change from (256, 1024) to (128, 512) could invalidate all existing parents, reset lowest_rank, then allow rejoining at a much lower rank than originally established. This might be intentional for network reconfiguration but should be documented.
